name: Graphene
description: Graphene is the NO-Group design language: near-black desaturated green-tinted neutrals, a single electric lime accent, and dense monospaced chrome. It is the visual identity applied to the Tungsten fork of VS Code.
principles: One accent. Lime carries every affordance that matters; nothing else competes.
Neutrals are tinted, never pure grey. Every surface carries a trace of green so the accent reads as part of the same family.
Dense over airy. Small type, tight rows, thin borders; the tool should feel like instrumentation.
Contrast is earned. Raise a surface only when it must be separable from the one behind it.

ramp.comment: Neutral surfaces, darkest to lightest. Each step is a deliberate stop, not an interpolation.

accent.comment: The single Graphene accent and its derived stops.

signal.comment: Status hues. Deliberately desaturated so the lime accent stays dominant.

syntax.comment: Token colours. Lime anchors declarations; everything else is cool or neutral so code reads calm.
